Agent Name: Filmography_Expert
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Filmography_Expert produced an incomplete and incorrectly filtered list of Isabelle Adjani feature films under 2 hours. Critically, they omitted “Nosferatu the Vampyre” (1979), which is under 2 hours, available on Vudu, and has a higher IMDb rating than the considered options. They also misapplied the duration filter by excluding other sub-120-minute titles they themselves listed (e.g., Barocco at 110 minutes). This upstream omission led subsequent agents to evaluate an incomplete candidate set, resulting in the incorrect final answer (“Subway”) instead of the correct one (“Nosferatu the Vampyre”).
